title: Clean Code
tagline: Write code humans love to read
description: Naming, small functions, error handling, the KISS / DRY / YAGNI rules of thumb, code smells, and Clean Architecture layers.

title: SOLID Principles
description: Single Responsibility, Open/Closed, Liskov Substitution, Interface Segregation and Dependency Inversion, each with a picture and a before/after example.

title: Design Patterns
description: The 22 classic Gang of Four patterns in three families (creational, structural, behavioral), explained with real-life analogies and short JavaScript examples.

title: Data Structures & Algorithms
description: Big-O, arrays, hash maps, linked lists, stacks, trees, heaps, graphs, sorting, binary search, recursion and dynamic programming, with a pattern cheat sheet for interviews.

title: Backend Engineering
description: How requests travel, API design (REST, GraphQL, gRPC), SQL vs NoSQL, indexing, caching with Redis, queues, authentication, scaling, Docker and backend languages.

title: Frontend Engineering
description: How browsers render, the JavaScript event loop, TypeScript, React and hooks, state management, Next.js rendering modes, performance, security and testing.

title: Microservices
description: Monolith vs microservices, service boundaries, sync vs async communication, API gateways, resilience patterns, sagas, the outbox pattern, CQRS and observability.

title: Apache Kafka
description: Topics, partitions and offsets, producers, consumer groups, replication, delivery guarantees, and when to choose Kafka over RabbitMQ.

title: Kubernetes
description: Containers to orchestration: cluster architecture, Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, Secrets, storage, autoscaling, health probes and Helm.
